task_title: Read-only native CI evidence lookup through connected GitHub
task_body: The connected GitHub interface can read stephanos/temporal despite the shell CLI's earlier 401. Identify available native Gomad runs/reports and exact remote source identities without push, dispatch or rerun. Preserve milestone acceptance and current source binding.
acceptance: A bounded source-bound evidence digest distinguishes matching, historical, missing and live results; PR-only first-page wrapper limits are explicit. No external or source mutation, qualification claim without report inspection, or new task admission.
